data.name: They Keep Rolling: Incremental Ball Roller
data.detailed_description:
"We hope you're enjoying the arcade! Huh, you want to leave? No no, you don't want to leave...not for a...long time..."

They Keep Rolling is an incremental ball-roller about earning trillions of tokens. Roll. Upgrade. Hire. Repeat. Before long, this whole cozy-creepy arcade is blinking and the prize counter is empty.

Roll, score, repeat
Line up your throw and let it fly. Land the high rings for big payouts, upgrade the ball for point increases, and pour everything you earn straight back into the machines.

Put the arcade on autopilot
Hire other animals in the arcade to roll for you. Buy pizza and sodas for the crew. Upgrade their machines too to go from millions to kabillions of tokens.

Every machine has a trick
No two machines play the same. Leaf tornadoes that hurl your ball upwards. Ghosts that grant extra tokens. The deeper you go, the stranger the machines get.

Meet the regulars
A twitchy grey squirrel who loves the games a little too much. A aimless deer looking for a break. A quiet raccoon who seems to know something you don't. The animals of Whispering Pines Arcade each have a story, and the longer you stay, the more you wonder...why do none of them ever leave?

Wrapped in a chunky PSX art style, warm 2000's arcade aesthetic, and the quiet hum of Appalachia, They Keep Rolling is easy to start and hard to put down.

Features

  • Ball-rolling built on an incremental economy that compounds every run

  • Dozens of upgrades that grow a single machine into a whole arcade floor

  • Hire friends to earn idle earnings, so your tokens keep climbing while you strategize

  • A cast of Appalachian animal regulars with a slow-burning mystery underneath

  • Prestige runs with permanent upgrades and more than one way to build
